subject: New works: colour, gesture and form | TUMO Gallery
subjectAlternatives: Discover new paintings and sculptures at TUMO
A new perspective: the latest works at TUMO Gallery
preheader: Paintings by Dubauskas and Theo Bardsley, expressive surfaces and Miglė Jašauskė’s Confessional sculptures.

translations.Nauji kūriniai: spalva, gestas ir forma: New works: colour, gesture and form | TUMO Gallery
translations.Dubausko tapyba, Theo Bardsley figūros i: Paintings by Dubauskas and Theo Bardsley, expressive surfaces and Miglė Jašauskė’s Confessional sculptures.
translations.Nauji kūriniai TUMO galerijoje — nuo did: Discover new works at TUMO Gallery: from large-scale paintings and scenes of everyday life to light-sensitive surfaces and wooden sculptures. Find a piece that catches your eye.
translations.Sodri geltona, mėlynos juostos ir laisva: Rich yellow, bands of blue and free-flowing brushwork. In this large-scale canvas, colour takes centre stage.
translations.Figūrų fragmentai, raudoni akcentai ir e: Fragments of figures, red accents and an energetic painterly rhythm.
translations.Metališkas paviršius ir žalsvi sluoksnia: A metallic surface and green-toned layers invite a closer look at the texture.
translations.Kasdienio susitikimo scena — tarp prisim: A scene of everyday encounters, somewhere between memory, colour and imagination.
translations.Rami figūra prie lango ir spalvingas pas: A quiet figure by the window, with a colourful world beyond.
translations.Pilki tonai ir stilizuotas veidas atveri: Grey tones and a stylised face offer a different take on portraiture.
translations.Permatomas vinilo paviršius leidžia vaiz: A translucent vinyl surface allows the image to change with the light.
translations.Medžio skulptūros su išdrožtomis ausimis: Wooden sculptures with carved ears invite you to pause and listen. Discover the Confessional series and find the piece that speaks to you.
translations.Du kūriniai, kuriuose asmeninė patirtis: Two works where personal experience meets the language of figurative painting.
translations.Peržiūrėkite galerijos kolekciją arba pa: Explore the gallery’s collection or get in touch. We’ll help you find the right piece and answer your questions about the works that interest you.
translations.Prieš siunčiant pridėkite siuntimo platf: Before sending, add your email platform’s automatic unsubscribe block.
